acceptanceCriteria: A public compatibility wrapper remains available, while the new governed path receives a single explicit observation context containing repository identity, Runtime identity, phase, snapshot identity, Contract/config/policy identities, observed facts, unknowns, and consistency state.

The context rejects or reports unknown when repository files change during observation, governance configuration changes, repository identity changes, or execution-phase mutation is detected; it never treats a struct aggregation as an atomic snapshot.
A single governance decision reuses the same validated facts and does not make lower-level project/governance helpers re-read repository identity or recompute an incompatible snapshot.
Existing Contract JSON, public API signatures through compatibility wrappers, CLI/MCP machine output, exit codes, governance semantics, and historical evidence remain unchanged.
Focused tests plus the full declared workspace, documentation, Runtime, and governance checks pass on the exact successor head.
goal: Separate observation and governance inputs so repository facts, Runtime identity, Contract/config/policy identity, observed unknowns, and consistency checks are captured once per valid observation phase and lower-level decision functions do not implicitly re-observe the repository.
intent: Complete the remaining P1-B architecture boundary by making one governance judgment consume one explicit, request-scoped and phase-scoped observation context, while preserving existing public APIs and fail-closed behavior.
outOfScope: No microservice, new crate, global cache, expanded snapshot lifetime across mutations, new governance rules, Outcome wording, protocol/serialization changes, lifecycle transition semantics, physical-execution sharing, or changes to another agent branch/PR.
Do not rewrite or close the historical WI-652/WI-654/WI-655/WI-657 PRs; this successor is independent.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Repeated governance reads in one valid phase use the same repository, Runtime, Contract/config/policy, snapshot, and observed-fact identities without a hidden second observation.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: stable observation reuses one request-scoped context
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused RepositoryExecutionContext and governance tests with call counters and assert one captured phase context and stable facts.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The observation phase is marked inconsistent or returns an unknown result; it cannot produce a green governance input.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: repository files change while observation is being read
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use a controlled mutation during observation and assert the before/after source snapshot identity mismatch is visible and fail closed.

scenarioCoverage.expected: cockpit/profile/policy declaration identity changes invalidate the phase context instead of being silently mixed with the original snapshot.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Mutate a bound governance declaration between phase captures and assert configuration identity mismatch and unknown state.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A context from another repository or a changed attached identity is rejected with the existing fail-closed identity behavior.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: repository identity changes or root does not match
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Bind two isolated repositories and tamper the attached identity input; assert snapshot-root or repository-identity mismatch.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A context captured before execution cannot authorize after-execution or persistence facts; the caller must capture and validate a new phase.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: execution-phase mutation requires a fresh boundary
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Mutate the fixture after the initial context and assert phase validation rejects reuse until a fresh context is captured.
